messages:
alex: heads-up - p95 on dedicated-eu2 jumped to 2200ms around 11:30UTC, looks correlated with backfill from reserved-backfill pool :thinking:
priya: saw that. any preempt logs?
infra-bot: ALERT: preemptible-backfill triggered on node gpu-uz-12, reason=pressure, action=fence_not_applied
sam: fence didn't apply? that's the preemption-fence we added last month.
priya: checking... kube taint not propagated to backfill pods during the topology shift; looks like the update hook failed
alex: routing policy may've allowed backfill -> dedicated slices while fence flag was pending. need to prevent that.
maria: can we add a router-side check to validate node annotations before routing? minimal change.
luke: quick mitigation: scaling down backfill pool by 30% and draining long-running backfills. running script.
sam: running: `./tools/scale-pool --pool backfill-eu2 --delta -30`
[shell output]
OK: 12 nodes cordoned and drain started
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolling 2/3 router instances with patch `check_node_fence=true`
priya: rolling routers now, will monitor p95 for the next 10m :eyes: 
alex: after mitigation p95 back to ~420ms, KV cache churn reduced but still elevated
maria: follow-up: planner should validate routing path vs node_fence annotation before committing backfill placements. put a barrier in the planner
priya: filing INFRA-4521: "planner preflight: enforce node_fence consistency w/ routing"
alex: assign INFRA-4521 to sam (planner) and luke (backfill autoscale lock). please add acceptance criteria and runbook
sam: ack, will add tests for annotation parity and a unit test for planner blocking
luke: ack, will add autoscale lock + soft-evict threshold and a quick rollback script
priya: nice work team :thumbsup: 
maria: added a short postmortem note in #postmortems link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INFRA-4521
alex: closing thread, keep an eye on cost impact from extra drains this month
